source_body.stem: A projectile is launched at 40 m/s at 30 degrees above the horizontal. What is its initial vertical velocity component?

source_contract.provenance_note: Synthetic golden fixture for production-kit validation; not a real examination source.

solution_steps: Use the launch triangle: the vertical component is u sin(theta).
Evaluate 40 sin(30 degrees) to obtain 20 m/s, which corresponds to the second option.
verification_route: The vertical component must be less than the launch speed and positive for an upward launch.

first_step_reference: Draw the launch velocity triangle and identify the component opposite the launch angle.

hint_seed.text: Notice which part of the launch velocity points vertically.
Resolve the launch vector into horizontal and vertical components using a right triangle.
Start with the vertical component relation u_y = u sin(theta).
